avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may decrease eletriptan levels; also increases serotonin independently
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or discontinue St. John's Wort before initiating eletriptan

avoid_supplements.name: 5-Hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; combined with triptan increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; counsel patient to discontinue 5-HTP before eletriptan therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Tryptophan supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; increases risk of serotonin syndrome when combined with triptan
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; recommend dietary sources only if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild serotonergic activity; potential additive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms; use lowest effective dose of eletriptan

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; may potentiate bleeding risk minimally
caution_supplements.action: Monitor if patient has bleeding tendency; generally safe at standard doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases eletriptan plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise complete avoidance of grapefruit products during eletriptan therapy

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Theoretical risk of hypertensive crisis with serotonergic agents; minimal clinical concern with triptans
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction needed; counsel on moderation if patient has hypertension

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heartbeat, muscle rigidity) if combined with other serotonergic agents. Assess blood pressure before and after initiation, particularly in patients with cardiovascular risk factors.
